data.rationale: The proposal includes the true core (Experience > Baggage allowance > choose cabin class), but it adds an unrelated travel-requirements step and the origin and destination parameters. The true workflow has none of those, so a build from this spec would do extra steps and the "Choose cabin class" step is vague, though the baggage part is concrete enough to automate.
